BoundedBitRepair:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (predict : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hp : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) predict)
    (k : ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ is : List ℕ, is.length = k ∧
      (x, is.foldl (fun word i => word.modify i Bool.not) (predict x)) ∈ R} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
HammingCoveredVerifier:
∀ (L : Language Bool) (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (predict : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hp : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) predict)
    (k : ℕ)
    (complete : ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L → ∃ w : List Bool,
      (x, w) ∈ R ∧ w.length = (predict x).length ∧
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => decide (a ≠ b)) (predict x) w).count true ≤ k)
    (sound : ∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → x ∈ L), L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
IndexedVerifierCollapse:
∀ (cover : ∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (p : Polynomial ℕ),
      PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R →
      (∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ p.eval x.length) →
      ∃ (clock : List Bool → List Bool) (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool),
        PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock ∧
        PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate ∧
        ∀ x : List Bool, (∃ w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R) →
          ∃ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R), PEqualNP.Library.P = PEqualNP.Library.NP
IndexedWitnessProjection:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (clock : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hc : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock)
    (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate), {x : List Bool | ∃ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
IndexedWitnessSearch:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (clock : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hc : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock)
    (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate), ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      (∀ x : List Bool,
        (∀ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∉ R) →
        search x = []) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ), i < (clock x).length →
        (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R →
        (∀ j < i, (x, generate (List.replicate j true, x)) ∉ R) →
        search x = true :: generate (List.replicate i true, x)
LogarithmicSuffixWitnesses:
∀ (L : Language Bool) (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (predict : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hp : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) predict)
    (q : Polynomial ℕ)
    (complete : ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L →
      ∃ s : List Bool, 2 ^ (s.length + 1) ≤ q.eval x.length ∧ (x, predict x ++ s) ∈ R)
    (sound : ∀ x s : List Bool, (x, predict x ++ s) ∈ R → x ∈ L), L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MaskedAndRepairedWitness:
∀ (L : Language Bool) (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (mask word : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hm : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) mask)
    (hw : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) word)
    (q : Polynomial ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hbudget : ∀ x : List Bool, 2 ^ ((mask x).count true + 1) ≤ q.eval x.length)
    (complete : ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L → ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = (mask x).length ∧
      (∀ i < (mask x).length, (mask x).getD i false = false → w.getD i false = (word x).getD i false) ∧
      ∃ is : List ℕ, is.length = k ∧ (x, is.foldl (fun w i => w.modify i Bool.not) w) ∈ R)
    (sound : ∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → x ∈ L), L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P

MeasuredBitFlip:
PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x)
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => p.2.modify p.1.length Bool.not)
MeasuredMaskedFill:
∃ fill : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) fill ∧
      ∀ mask word seed : List Bool,
        fill (List.replicate mask.length true ++ false :: (mask ++ word), seed) =
          (List.range mask.length).map (fun i =>
            if mask.getD i false then seed.getD ((mask.take i).count true) false else word.getD i false)
PrefixExtensionNP:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (p : Polynomial ℕ)
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (hbound : ∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ p.eval x.length), ∃ L : Language Bool, L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP ∧ ∀ x u : List Bool,
      List.replicate x.length true ++ false :: (x ++ u) ∈ L ↔
      ∃ w : List Bool, (x, u ++ w) ∈ R
VerifierSearchCollapse:
PEqualNP.Library.P = PEqualNP.Library.NP ↔
      ∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (p : Polynomial ℕ),
        PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R →
        (∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ p.eval x.length) →
        ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
          PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
          ∀ x : List Bool, (∃ w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R) → (x, search x) ∈ R
VerifierSearchFromPrefixDecider:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (p : Polynomial ℕ)
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (bound : ∀ x w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ p.eval x.length)
    (D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (spec : ∀ x u : List Bool, List.replicate x.length true ++ false :: (x ++ u) ∈ D ↔
      ∃ w : List Bool, (x, u ++ w) ∈ R), ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, (∃ w : List Bool, (x, w) ∈ R) → (x, search x) ∈ R
